title: Easy_to_Hear_3d9083bd
style: Acoustic pop with a folk-rock influence. The arrangement features a fingerpicked acoustic guitar as the primary harmonic and rhythmic driver, accompanied by a subtle kick drum and shaker. A male tenor vocal delivers the melody with a clean, intimate tone, occasionally layering into harmonies during the chorus. A melodic electric guitar with light overdrive and delay provides lead fills and counter-melodies. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a warm, rounded tone. The tempo is 100 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of G Major.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar, light shaker]

[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals]
Some songs try to be complicated
Some songs need a dictionary
This one only needs you listening
That's the only commentary
Easy to hear, easy to feel
Easy to know that the words are real
No production hiding what it means
Easy to hear
That's the thing

[Chorus]
[kick drum enters, bass guitar enters]
Easy to hear
No barrier
[electric guitar lead fills with delay]
Just the voice and what it says
Easy to hear today
Easy to hear
Today

[Verse 2]
[acoustic guitar continues, shaker becomes more prominent]
Thirty languages could carry this
Ten cultures could hold the thread
The simplest melody survives
Long after the complex is dead
Most of us know the principle
The lesson lands when it's simple
Easy to hear, easy to learn
Easy to feel, easy to earn
You don't have to work hard to feel this
That's the point
It's always been the point

[Chorus]
[fuller arrangement, layered vocal harmonies]
Easy to hear
Easy to hold
Easy to hear
Warm, not cold
Simple is the hardest to write
Easy to hear, done it right
Just listen
[vocal ad-libs, high tenor register]
(Mmm, that's all)
Easy

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[acoustic guitar fades out]
[electric guitar final sustained note]
